answer: Treat reputation as water from the oasis, carried by a vine each identity must grow: a vine thickens only when a client who already drinks from the oasis verifies a completed job, and flow through any single edge is capped. A sybil cluster fed by one honest link can only sip a trickle, however many faces it sprouts, because its vines stay thin without genuine edges. Each thickening leaves a plume of settled deliveries, visible to all. Faking a thousand thick vines means buying a thousand real edges — a thousand real jobs for real clients — the same price as earning them honestly.
